title: French-Style Mushroom Crepes
description: Delicious crepes filled with a savory mushroom mixture, making for a quick and satisfying French-inspired meal.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, and a pinch of salt.
Gradually add in the whole milk, whisking until smooth.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat and add a small amount of butter.
Once the butter has melted, add in the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add in the onions and garlic and cook until the onions are translucent.
Add in the cooked mushroom mixture to the crepe batter and stir to combine.
Heat a large non-stick pan over medium heat and add a small amount of butter.
Once the butter has melted, add in a small amount of the crepe batter and tilt the pan to evenly coat the bottom.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the edges start to curl and the surface is dry.
Loosen the crepe with a spatula and flip it over.
Cook for another 1-2 minutes, until the other side is also cooked through.
Repeat with the remaining batter, until all the crepes are cooked.
To serve, place a cooked crepe on a plate and add a spoonful of the mushroom filling in the center.
Fold the crepe in half over the filling and serve immediately.
